status.busy: Display in use by another program
preview.label: Screen preview
preview.alt: Live preview of the desk display
preview.footnote: The preview is the exact image sent to the display, refreshed every second.
controls.label: Screen controls
controls.screenDesc: Turn it off for now. It stays off until you turn it back on, or Vigil restarts.
controls.off: The screen is off. The preview shows what it would show.
controls.gaming: A full-screen game is running, so the screen keeps to {view}.
controls.held: {view} stays on the screen until you let the views take turns again.
controls.next: Next: {view} in {seconds}s. Pick a view to keep it on the screen.
controls.othersWaiting: The other views have nothing to show yet.
controls.single: Only one view is switched on.
update.current: You have {version}. Your settings are kept.
update.downloading: Downloading the update. Vigil closes and opens again by itself.
update.failed: The update could not be installed: {error}
views.title: Views
views.desc: What takes turns on the screen.
views.lastOn: At least one view stays on
views.gameDesc: After 5 seconds of a game or video filling the PC's screen, until you leave it.
view.clock.name: Clock
view.system.name: System
view.system.desc: CPU and GPU temperature and load, memory in use.
view.weather.name: Weather and quote
view.weather.desc: Current weather for your city and the quote of the day.
view.world.name: World clocks
view.world.desc: The time in up to three other cities.
view.music.name: Now playing
view.music.desc: Cover, title and progress of what is playing. Shown only while something plays.
look.title: Appearance
look.orientationDesc: Turned to the right means its top edge now faces right. If the picture shows sideways, pick the other upright one.
look.nightDesc: Turns the backlight down between two times.
design.title: System screen
design.desc: How the system view looks. The previews use sample numbers.
design.label: System design
design.tiles: Cards, left to right, top row first
design.minimal.name: Minimal
design.minimal.desc: Three big numbers and nothing else.
design.panel.name: Full panel
design.panel.desc: Everything at once, neatly in a grid.
design.gauges.name: Gauges
design.gauges.desc: Two big dials for the CPU and the GPU.
design.bars.name: Bars
design.bars.desc: A list of meters, one line each.
design.graphs.name: Graphs
design.graphs.desc: The last few minutes of load and network.
design.dashboard.name: Dashboard
design.dashboard.desc: Everything in cards over the whole screen: CPU, GPU, network, volume, time, memory and disk.
design.custom.name: Custom
design.custom.desc: Six cards, and you pick what each one shows.
cpu.off.title: See the CPU's temperature
cpu.off.desc: Windows only shows it to programs that run as administrator with a driver. Until then, the screen shows the CPU load in its place.
cpu.denied.title: Windows didn't grant administrator rights
cpu.denied.desc: CPU temperature is on, but this time Vigil runs without the rights it needs. Try again, and choose Yes when Windows asks.
cpu.driver.title: One step left: the PawnIO driver
cpu.driver.desc: Install PawnIO, then press Check again. Vigil doesn't need to restart.
cpu.unsupported.title: This CPU's sensor can't be read yet
cpu.unsupported.desc: Everything is set up, but this CPU isn't supported by the sensor library yet. The screen shows the load instead. Approximate CPU temperature, under System, gives a rough figure.
weather.title: Weather
weather.desc: For the weather view. Updated every 30 minutes from Open-Meteo.
weather.none: No city chosen yet. The weather view is skipped until you pick one.
weather.searchFailed: Could not search. Check the internet connection.
world.title: World clocks
world.desc: Up to three cities, top to bottom.
system.title: System
system.desc: How Vigil runs on this PC.
system.lockDesc: Dim shows only the time, with the backlight low. Before the PC sleeps, the screen always turns off.
system.autostartDesc: Opens in the notification area when you sign in.
system.admin.on: On. Vigil is running as administrator and reads the CPU sensors.
system.admin.onEachStart: On. Vigil is running as administrator. Installed for you only, so Windows asks each time Vigil starts. Install it for all users to be asked once.
system.admin.denied: On, but Windows did not grant administrator rights this time.
system.admin.off: Needs administrator rights. Windows asks once, then Vigil restarts.
system.admin.offEachStart: Needs administrator rights. Installed for you only, so Windows asks each time Vigil starts. Install it for all users to be asked once.
system.approxDesc: Without the driver, shows the motherboard's ACPI temperature instead, marked ~. It is often well below the CPU's own, so it is off unless you want it.
system.updatesDesc: Once a day, asks GitHub whether there is a newer version. Nothing about you or this PC is sent.
system.diagnosticsDesc: Copies the versions, the display's state, the settings and the end of the log, to paste into a bug report. No city, name or readings.
system.copyFailed: Could not copy: another program is using the clipboard.
tray.updateFound: Version {version} is available. Right-click the icon to update, or open Vigil to see what's new.
tray.updateFailed: The update could not be installed: {error}
tray.busy: Vigil: the display is in use by another program
tray.asleep: Vigil: paused while the PC sleeps
app.alreadyRunning: Vigil is already running. Open it from its icon in the taskbar's notification area.
app.autostartFailed: Could not change the start-up entry: {error}
app.webview2Missing:
Vigil's window needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which is missing on this PC.
Install it from microsoft.com/edge/webview2. The display keeps working meanwhile.
